label: Air changes (peak)
advice_low: Raise ventilation: run the HVAC on a higher outdoor-air setting during class; if that is not possible, add a HEPA portable cleaner or open windows and doors when weather allows.
advice_high: Ventilation looks excessive — check for windows stuck open in cold weather and balance with energy use.

label: Air changes (typical)
advice_low: Raise ventilation: run the HVAC on a higher outdoor-air setting during class; if that is not possible, add a HEPA portable cleaner or open windows and doors when weather allows.
advice_high: Ventilation looks excessive — check for windows stuck open in cold weather and balance with energy use.

label: PM2.5 (peak)
source: WHO 24-h guideline 15 µg/m³; US EPA 24-h standard 35 µg/m³
advice_high: Run a HEPA PAC on high during class; damp-dust surfaces; vacuum with a HEPA vacuum; keep windows closed on high outdoor-pollution days.

label: PM2.5 (typical)
source: WHO 24-h guideline 15 µg/m³ is a daily mean — fits this column
advice_high: Run a HEPA PAC on high during class; damp-dust surfaces; vacuum with a HEPA vacuum; keep windows closed on high outdoor-pollution days.

label: CO2 (peak)
source: ASHRAE CO2 comfort indicator ~1000 ppm in schools
advice_high: Bring in more fresh air: raise the HVAC outdoor-air rate, air the room between classes, and stagger high-occupancy activities.

label: CO2 (typical)
source: ASHRAE CO2 comfort indicator ~1000 ppm in schools
advice_high: Bring in more fresh air: raise the HVAC outdoor-air rate, air the room between classes, and stagger high-occupancy activities.

label: Temperature average
advice_low: Room runs cool — check the thermostat setpoint and heating delivery to this room.
advice_high: Room runs warm — check the cooling setpoint, shading, and heat sources; ventilate in the cool morning.

label: Humidity average
advice_low: Air is dry — check humidification and watch for static and comfort complaints.
advice_high: Air is damp — run the HVAC fan longer, check for leaks, and watch for mold risk above 60%.

label: VOC (peak)
advice_high: Ventilate during and after cleaning; switch to low-VOC products; remove fragrance sources; run a PAC with a carbon filter.

label: VOC (typical)
advice_high: Ventilate during and after cleaning; switch to low-VOC products; remove fragrance sources; run a PAC with a carbon filter.
